name: application-playback-speed-menu
title: Playback Speed Menu
description: Video player settings menu with a checkmarked playback-speed list and a navigable Quality submenu, both driven by real selection state.
useWhen: Building a video/media player's settings control for playback speed and quality.
You need a single-select list with a visible checkmark on the current choice, not just hover highlighting.
A secondary set of options (quality) benefits from its own navigable panel rather than cluttering the main list.
avoidWhen: You need a generic single-level action menu (links, delete, etc.) — use `dropdown` for that flatter menu pattern instead.
There's only one option group with no drill-down — a flat checkmarked list without the submenu/back navigation is enough.
The menu needs to support multi-select — this pattern is single-select (menuitemradio) per panel.
responsiveBehavior: Fixed-width menu panel (w-52) anchored to its trigger button; swaps between the main and quality panel in place rather than resizing.
accessibility: Each option uses role="menuitemradio" with aria-checked reflecting real selection state, and the checkmark icon's visibility always matches that same state.
The Quality submenu has its own back button that returns focus-visible context to the main panel rather than closing the whole menu.
The trigger button exposes aria-haspopup and aria-expanded so assistive tech announces it as a menu control.

variants.title: Playback Speed Menu
variants.description: Settings menu with Normal speed selected and Auto (1080p) quality; clicking Quality navigates to a submenu with its own checkmarked list and back button.
accessibility: Checkmark visibility and aria-checked are both derived from the same selected speed/quality state, verified interactively.

variants.title: Playback Speed Menu (Dark)
variants.description: Playback speed menu adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Menu panel and checkmark colors are tuned to meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
